sana (CS): Heads-up — CorpWise hit repeated 500s on Dedicated tonight, sending repro and logs below. Customer impact: production traffic (small set of users).

sana (CS): Repro steps I used in our staging (Dedicated v2.1):
1) Checkout customer config: model=redwood-7b-dedicated-v2, max_context=8192, route=dedicated-us-west
2) curl against their endpoint: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://dedicated-api.redwood.example/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-dedicated-v2","input":"SYSTEM:[long system prompt]\nUSER: summarize attachments","max_tokens":512}'
```
3) Results: about 1/3 of requests return HTTP 500 with empty body within 200-350ms. Others succeed.

sana (CS): Relevant bits from the node proxy logs (staged):
```
[2026-02-08T02:13:09Z] request_id=rcp-9f12 error=500 backend=runtime-12 msg="runtime error, nil pointer"
[2026-02-08T02:13:09Z] stack=runtime/kv_cache.go:214: (*KVCache).Merge+0x1a
[2026-02-08T02:13:09Z] traceback=goroutine 42 [running]:
```

eli (eng): Thx. Can you paste the full stacktrace + request_id for one failing call? Also what GPU type was used in the Dedicated pool?

sana (CS): Attached full trace and request_id rcp-9f12. GPU type: p4d. Runtime image: redwood-runtime:2.3.4. Customer reports intermittent failures since yesterday evening.

maya (eng): I reproduced locally on a p4d replica with the same runtime and model. Getting same 500 and stack implicates kv_cache Merge. Quick log: 
```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
  at github.com/redwood/runtime/kv_cache.go:214 (0x7f1a2b)
  at github.com/redwood/runtime/handler.go:128
```

maya (eng): Root cause hypothesis: code path that merges cached prefixes fails when no prefix metadata exists for very long system prompts — a nil check missing after cache miss.

tomas (pm): Ok — impact: single large customer, production but limited traffic. Suggest P1 if customer revenue at risk, else P2. @sana do they have deadlines?

sana (CS): Customer says it's blocking a feature launch tomorrow morning for 10% of users. They asked for an ETA or workaround.

tomas (pm): Marking P1. Need a short-term mitigation + engineering fix. @eli can you pick up as owner?

eli (eng): I'll own the fix. Plan: 1) add nil guard in kv_cache Merge and add unit test to cover long-system-prompt path; 2) backport to 2.3.x runtime; 3) patch deploy to Dedicated pool + coordinated rollout. ETA 72h.

maya (eng): I can push a hotfix branch with the nil guard and unit tests. Quick mitigation: route CorpWise traffic to hosted API or a different Dedicated pool without p4d for 24-48h. Ops-bot please open a routing change ticket.

ops-bot: Ticket created -> INC-8342 (temporary routing change to hosted for corpwise-prod).

eli (eng): Acceptance criteria for engineering intake: 
- Repro command above fails before fix and succeeds after fix in staging (same runtime image).
- Unit test added to cover cache miss + long system prompt.
- Backported patch in 2.3.x with release notes.
- Post-deploy: zero 500s for 24h on previously failing requests.

tomas (pm): Adding to product backlog as "CS-4287: CorpWise Dedicated 500s on long system prompts" with P1 tag. Include repro steps and logs.

sana (CS): Notified customer about mitigation options (route to hosted or lower context length). They accepted temporary routing to hosted and want ETA for full fix.

eli (eng): Created PR #5612 -> draft hotfix. Linking INC-8342 and CS-4287. Setting milestone: quickfix-2.3.5.

maya (eng): I'll run integration tests against dedicated staging after PR lands. If green, we can deploy to canary pool and monitor.

sana (CS): Thanks team — I'll update customer with ETA 72h and confirm when routing change is live. :thumbsup:
